value:
BOUNDARY LAW for the composed permute+recolor class opened by claim.law.RQ_webfrank-audit-silence-is-not-ineligibility.20260901.v1. That law is CORRECT that audit silence is not ineligibility, and its 4-step procedure is sound; this record adds the PRECONDITION its procedure does not state, which decides membership before any rule is authored, and which splits the class in two.

THE PRECONDITION. apply_patch runs instruction_permutation FIRST and copy_register_fields SECOND, in a fixed order (this is the operative content of claim.law.webfrank-permutation-is-audited-in-our-colouring.20260831.v1). Therefore the permutation must be legal in OUR colouring STANDING ALONE, i.e. before any register field is touched. A displaced word is closable ONLY IF its movement does not cross a def-use edge that exists in our colouring. When the displacement and the recolor are INDEPENDENT the composition works; when the displacement is CAUSED BY the recolor it is structurally unreachable, because the very register assignment that produced the displacement is what makes the reorder illegal, and the stage that would fix the register runs too late to help.

THE DISCRIMINATOR, applicable by inspection in one step: look at the register the displaced word (or the words it must move past) DEFINES, and ask whether any word it crosses READS that register in our colouring. If yes, the function is NOT a member and no rule can be authored; if no, run the RQ procedure.

WORKED MEMBER (closable): StartThrowMagicFX (attempt.RQ_startthrowmagicfx-permute-recolor-closure.20260901.v1). The displaced clrlwi defines r28 and reads r25; none of the three atoms it crosses writes r25 or touches r28; check_permutation_dependences passes in its STRICTEST form with exit_dead=None, and the rule closed the function to real 0.

WORKED NON-MEMBER (structurally closed): fakelib::sceOpen, previously nominated as 'member #2' of this population by attempt.NX_sceopen-is-a-second-permute-plus-recolor-candidate.20260901.v1. Its residual reads identically at the summary level: 99/99 instructions, identical opcode multiset, one unpaired store plus a recolor. But the aligned view shows ours `lis r4,sFileSlots@ha ; stw r5,16(r1) ; addi r5,r4,@lo` against target `lis r4,@ha ; addi r4,r4,@lo ; stw r5,16(r1)`. The store is displaced ONLY BECAUSE our build forms the address into r5: the store must read the incoming vararg r5 before the addi overwrites it, whereas the target forms into r4, already saved one instruction earlier, and is free to hoist. MEASURED: check_permutation_dependences over [0x48,0x50) with order [1,0] fails with `breaks def-use chains: [(0, ('g',5))]`, and it fails IDENTICALLY with exit_dead=lambda r: True, the loosest escape the API admits. That is the decisive detail: exit_dead can only excuse a changed FINAL WRITE, never a broken def-use CHAIN, so no escape, no widened window (also measured negative over [0x44,0x50) order [0,2,1] and [0x44,0x54) order [0,2,1,3]) and no rule formulation reaches it. The rejection is semantically CORRECT, not a guard being conservative: performing the swap in our colouring would store the sFileSlots address into the varargs save area instead of the caller's r5.

CONSEQUENCE FOR TRIAGE. The RQ law's triage rule ('a park whose residual is identical multiset, N displaced words, plus recolor is a WebFrank CANDIDATE the audit will never nominate') must be read with this filter attached, or it will nominate functions that cannot be closed and each will cost a full manual derivation to discover it. Cost of applying the filter: one call to check_permutation_dependences, before authoring anything. Apply it as step 0 of the RQ procedure, ahead of the dependence audit at its step 3, since it is the same call used as a MEMBERSHIP test rather than as a proof step.

SCOPE NOTE. This does not weaken the RQ law and does not restore the parent 'unpaired words bar candidacy' law to its over-broad reading: displaced words remain reachable in general. It names which displacements are reachable. It also does not bear on the genuine hard walls (unequal instruction counts, count-asymmetric residuals), which remain absolutely closed in both directions.
